dict.string: Figolu reads your calendar to name your notes after the meeting and to know who is in it. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Figolu checks the browser tab's name to tell when you're in a call, and pauses your music while it records.
Figolu records your voice in meetings so it can write the transcript and your notes. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Figolu records the sound of your calls so it can write down what others say. Nothing leaves your Mac.
